fields.description: Automatic series for the transfer number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Who is moving. Only their placement changes; nothing else about them is touched.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: Where the volunteer is placed today, taken from their record when the transfer is raised. It does not change afterwards.
fields.label: From

fields.description: Where the volunteer is moving to. Must be a different branch, at a level this society places volunteers at.
fields.label: To

fields.description: The day the volunteer belongs to the new branch. A future date waits until that day.
fields.label: Effective Date

fields.description: Where this transfer stands: pending, effective once the volunteer has moved, or cancelled. Set by the system.
fields.label: Transfer Status

fields.description: When the volunteer's placement was actually moved. Empty until the transfer takes effect.
fields.label: Applied On

fields.description: Why the volunteer is moving, in your own words. Read by whoever approves the transfer.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Where the approval stands. Set by the approval engine, and left at Draft where the society does not route transfers.
fields.label: Approval State
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
In Review
Approved
Rejected
Withdrawn
Expired

fields.description: The approval stage under review. Set by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Stage

fields.description: When the current approval stage was entered. Used to measure how long a decision is taking.
fields.label: Stage Entered On

fields.description: Who decided what, when and why. Written by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Decisions
